# Spring rates and coil types

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Understand linear springs compress at a constant rate and use 2.5-inch or remote reservoir Titan-length coils for T-swap applications. [t553]

## Specifications

- **Heavy load coil rate (OME)**: ~530 lb/in [t553] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Stock Bilstein spring rate**: ~600 lb/in [t553] ([Unverified] single report)

## Tips & gotchas

- Use 2.5-inch or remote reservoir Titan-length coilovers for T-swap applications. [t553]
